messages.subject: using my own dataset
parts:
Hello,

So, the simple example of cycling between rock, pressure, and cars.  What if I want to replace "pressure" with my own ".rda" that I have uploaded to rstudio?

Thanks,

Josh

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: using my own dataset
parts:
Just make sure the .rda is in the same directory as ui.R and server.R, then somewhere near the top of your server.R file you can load it up. The pressure dataset is essentially just a normal R variable, so you can replace it with your own.

Let me know if that doesn't help, or better yet, post a gist of what you tried, and we'll get you pointed in the right direction.
